title.en: the alemany flea market at nine.

line.en: the sunday flea on alemany boulevard in bernal heights, free to walk in. go early for the good stalls; it runs until mid-afternoon.
line.de: der sonntags-flohmarkt am alemany boulevard in bernal heights, eintritt frei. früh kommen für die guten stände; bis in den nachmittag.
line.tr: bernal heights'ta alemany bulvarı'ndaki pazar günü pazarı, girişi ücretsiz. iyi tezgâhlar için erken git; öğleden sonraya kadar açık.

sparks.why: Alemany Flea Market, 100 Alemany Blvd, open Sundays 7am to 3pm and free, per a flea market guide (fleamarketinsiders.com, timeout.com); the city runs it through the Real Estate Division (sf.gov).
